name: Config Planner Agent
description: Autonomous config planner for P0 Nominal: calls monitoring and validation agents (A2A), runs optimization inference, and enforces the final P0 Nominal to the physical network after validation.

skills.description: Forwards requests to the Monitoring Agent to monitor the network configuration and KPIs, adding context to the chat.
examples: What are the current P0 Nominal and uplink throughput of the XYZ network?
Can you tell me the uplink throughput of the ABC network?
skills.name: Monitoring

skills.description: Based on the results provided by the Monitoring Agent, propose a new P0 Nominal value and apply it in the network after validating it with the Validation Agent.
examples: Please optimize the P0 Nominal of the network XYZ to increase the uplink throughput.
skills.name: Optimization
